title: mailbox-open: warn at open time when a cloud seat names a --head that --close will not delete (not claude/mailbox-*)
body:
domain:server#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcTJTE7kSbcMoJQ4Txf

Filing-gate category: ③ a maintainer-directed task. The seat proposed it in its Claude Code session after clock-out (2026-11-08), and the maintainer answered verbatim: 「同意」.

## What happened

`domain:server#1` opened its mailbox (#31077) with `mailbox-open.mjs --head claude/exciting-thompson-me4olw`, the session's designated branch, because the session may push only that branch. At clock-out, `mailbox-open.mjs --close 31077` closed the pull and printed that the head was left: the relay's `mailbox_branch_delete` deletes only a `claude/mailbox-*` head (`MAILBOX_BRANCH_SHAPE`, ruling 6674408912 letter A; #30350). The close behaved as designed, and the branch is left behind for a person to delete. The script's own header already says a cloud seat names the head `claude/mailbox-<slug>`. Nothing enforced that at open time, so the gap surfaced only at clock-out.

## Ask

1. `mailbox-open.mjs`, open with `--head`: when the head does not match `MAILBOX_BRANCH_SHAPE`, print one loud warning before the pull is created. The warning says that `--close` will leave this branch, and names the `claude/mailbox-<slug>` spelling. Exit code and behaviour are otherwise unchanged. Add a `--self-test` case.
2. ⛔ Do not widen `mailbox_branch_delete` or `MAILBOX_BRANCH_SHAPE`. The delete fence stays as ruled.
3. **Refusal instead of a warning is out of scope until the maintainer rules on it.** It would require cloud seats to push a `claude/mailbox-*` branch, which conflicts with a session limited to its designated branch, unless a `/pm-dispatch` summons is ruled to authorize that push. If refusal is wanted later, that is a decision card first.

Reader: the `domain:skills` lane (non-gate `scripts/pm/**` PM tooling). Triage routes and grades it.

Dedupe (2026-11-08): `mailbox-open head claude/mailbox` → 28 hits (top: #30350 closed, the close-side delete this card leaves as is; #26620 a seat post); `mailbox branch left after close` → 108 (seat posts); `mailbox-open --head warn` → 18 (seat posts, unrelated closed cards). None covers the open-time warning.
